utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Dane. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking the list, but I know the front step and the loose kitchen hinge still need work.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, I’ll keep track of those two and wait for the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I’ll help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Can you confirm you’re free tomorrow and have the right tools?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I’m free tomorrow and I have the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and a box of screws if the repair drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great, that might come in handy. I’ll let the others know you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing, I’ll keep them set aside and ready if anyone needs more.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is underway. Let me know if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. Could you help me figure out the pickup and drop-off details? I want to make sure I can plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Tell me what times and locations you have in mind, and I’ll help sort the pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time do you want me to bring the tools over?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Around six should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring them over around six then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus, I heard the repair drive is picking up more volunteers this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s good to hear. I’ve got a few tools ready if they need them this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’ll be handy, Gus. I’ll tell folks to look for you this afternoon if they need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Opal. I can round up a few more hands for the repair drive if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d help a lot. Have them meet at the east lot by nine, and tell me if anyone needs tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, I’ll tell folks to meet at the east lot by nine and ask around for any tool needs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm the repair drive is the one behind the house, and I need to know when you can start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s the repair drive behind the house, and I can start this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Bo. Tell me who needs help first and I’ll line up the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with whoever’s in the worst shape first. I’ll take a quick look at the list and send the next names after that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense, Bo. I’ll put the worst-off homes at the top and wait for your next names.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll mention it to the others.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Please keep me posted when you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll keep you posted as soon as I know the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to ask you if you still needed a hand with that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think so, if you don't mind. I've got a bit more than I can handle alone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can help with that. Just point me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m heading over to help with the repair drive. Want me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: If you can grab some gloves, that’d help a lot. Maybe a box cutter too, in case we need to open up any packages.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll grab gloves and a box cutter on my way over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about the repair drive, so you should come by too. We could use another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be a little late, but I can stop by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, come whenever you can. I’ll keep a spot open for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, but I need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, I’ve got the drive with me. I’ll bring the details over so we can sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, bring it over and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the drive after school pickup if that works. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works. Could you handle sign-in and the table at the front, and I’ll bring the repair list and supplies?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’ll take sign-in and the front table after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive — what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve still got a few things to sort, but I can walk you through what’s left and we’ll split it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, walk me through it and I’ll take one piece off your hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia. I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I may take you up on that, but I need to make sure we can get everything there and back without running short.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That makes sense. I can help load and unload so we only take what fits.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the repair drive location if you want. What place are we heading to?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we’re heading to the community center on Maple, near the old library. It’s the first stop on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the community center on Maple by the old library is first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the time and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you let me know the time once you check?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Cleo. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a list started: we still need to sort the materials and get the broken pieces collected. I’ll bring what I have, and if you can handle the heavy lifting, we can get it done fast.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll handle the heavy lifting and help sort the materials too. Just point me to the broken pieces and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive going on, but I only got that secondhand. Is it still happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it's still going on, though I might be a little behind on the details. You should check with whoever's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll check with the organizer then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive still starts at the community hall, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it still starts at the community hall. I heard they were setting the tables out there this morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, at the community hall, not somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up today. I can swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, thanks. I’m a bit behind, so I appreciate you checking.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, I’ll stop by after I’m done and see what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to check on that this morning, but I lost track. Is Leo still waiting on me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I’m still waiting. Can you give me a quick update?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, sorry — I’m still on it, and I should have checked in sooner. I’ll give you a real update in a few minutes.
